identity.title: Govern validation scope authority before acceptance

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: EverRun dogfood produced accepted runs where validation was green but the shared execution state contained changes outside the pack-authorized scope. Ailuros already has 8102's validation-state-equivalence gate; do not duplicate it. Add one separate, framework-neutral pre-use gate for validation scope authority. The integrating runtime/adapter supplies opaque validation_scope_ref, authorized_scope_ref and observed_change_scope_ref values plus an explicit scope_alignment classification and evidence references. Ailuros records the request and allows the validation result to act as authoritative acceptance evidence only when scope alignment is explicitly confirmed with evidence; explicit contamination blocks that evidence use; unknown or insufficient evidence requires review. Ailuros must not inspect Git, infer test-to-source coverage, or reinterpret a passed validation result as failed.
human_pressure.goal: Separate validation success from validation authority so a green result cannot authorize acceptance when its execution/change scope is explicitly evidenced as contaminated relative to the governed scope.
non_goals: Do not replace or widen 8102's validation-state-equivalence gate.
Do not inspect Git status, diffs, pack files, test discovery, coverage data or validation commands inside Ailuros core.
Do not infer which source files a test command covers.
Do not change core.ValidationResult or turn a passed validation fact into a failed validation fact.
Do not build a generic provenance, lineage, attestation or scope graph subsystem.
red_lines: Opaque scope-reference equality must never be treated as proof of scope alignment.
Dirty/clean workspace state and changed-file counts must not become universal Ailuros rules.
Explicit contamination affects authority to consume validation evidence for acceptance; it does not rewrite the validation result itself.
Unknown or unsupported scope alignment must not silently become ALLOW or BLOCK.
do_not_misread: This is validation-evidence authority, not validation execution and not repository hygiene.
The producer/runtime or adapter owns producer-specific derivation of scope_alignment.
Ailuros consumes explicit scope facts and decides whether the validation evidence may authorize acceptance.
8102 state equivalence and this scope-authority gate are independent conditions; neither silently implies the other.

machine_core.goal: Add AilurosRuntime.before_validation_scope_use(...) as a deterministic auditable gate that keeps validation result status separate from whether that result has sufficient scope authority to support acceptance.
acceptance: RuntimeEventType contains VALIDATION_SCOPE_USE_REQUESTED with wire value 'validation_scope_use_requested', and tests/test_models.py is updated inside declared scope for the canonical event-count assertion if required.

AilurosRuntime exposes before_validation_scope_use(run_id, validation_id, validation_scope_ref, authorized_scope_ref, observed_change_scope_ref, scope_alignment, evidence_refs=None, metadata=None) returning GovernanceDecision.
The VALIDATION_SCOPE_USE_REQUESTED event is recorded before the resulting GOVERNANCE_DECISION.
Request and decision metadata preserve validation_id, all three opaque scope refs, scope_alignment, evidence_refs and caller metadata without parsing the refs.
scope_alignment='confirmed' with at least one evidence reference returns ALLOW and allowed=true.
scope_alignment='contaminated' with at least one evidence reference returns BLOCK and allowed=false, scoped only to using that validation evidence as authoritative acceptance evidence.
scope_alignment='unknown', an unrecognized classification, or missing/empty evidence_refs returns REQUIRE_REVIEW and allowed=false.
The decision carries the supplied evidence_refs and a deterministic input_hash derived from the scope-use request facts.
The implementation never compares scope refs to infer alignment and never inspects Git, validation commands, test coverage or changed-file counts.
Existing 8102 validation-state-equivalence behavior and 8105 action-outcome consistency behavior remain unchanged.
All focused and full validation commands pass.
red_lines: Do not modify DecisionResolver, Policy, PolicyEngine, GovernanceDecisionType or core.ValidationResult.
Do not add Git/subprocess/worktree/test-coverage inspection to AilurosRuntime.
Do not derive scope_alignment from equality or inequality of opaque scope refs.
Do not fold this capability into 8102 by breaking or silently strengthening the existing before_validation_evidence_use API.
Do not generalize into a universal evidence authority graph, provenance platform or artifact registry.
Do not terminate, retry, repair or otherwise orchestrate the external runtime.
failure_semantics: Confirmed alignment without supporting evidence is insufficient and must REQUIRE_REVIEW.
Explicit contamination with supporting evidence BLOCKS only authoritative use of the validation result for acceptance.
Unknown, unrecognized or incomplete scope evidence must REQUIRE_REVIEW rather than guess.
A BLOCK here never changes the producer's validation result from passed to failed.
Producer-specific derivation such as Git/worktree set comparison remains outside Ailuros core.
invariants: Validation success and validation authority remain separate facts.
Only explicit confirmed scope alignment plus evidence may authorize validation evidence use under this gate.
Governance evidence is recorded before downstream acceptance consumes the validation evidence.
Existing runtime-governance APIs retain their current semantics.

must_check: The change adds one narrow validation-scope authority gate and does not duplicate 8102's state-equivalence logic.
VALIDATION_SCOPE_USE_REQUESTED is emitted before GOVERNANCE_DECISION and the canonical event-count test is updated only if needed.
Confirmed plus non-empty evidence_refs yields ALLOW; contaminated plus non-empty evidence_refs yields BLOCK; unknown/unrecognized/insufficient evidence yields REQUIRE_REVIEW.
All scope refs are preserved as opaque values and are never compared to infer alignment.
A passed validation result is not rewritten as failed; only its authority to support acceptance is governed.
No Git/worktree/test-coverage/changed-file heuristic or producer-specific parser is introduced.
The decision carries evidence_refs and deterministic input_hash.
8102 validation-state-equivalence, 8105 action-outcome consistency, state-handoff, actor-substitution and tool-call governance remain green.
No forbidden files changed and every validation command passed.
reject_if: The implementation derives scope alignment from scope-ref equality/inequality, Git status, diff shape, changed-file counts, test names or coverage inference.
The implementation changes core.ValidationResult or represents contaminated scope as validation execution failure.
The implementation weakens, removes or silently changes 8102 before_validation_evidence_use semantics.
Unknown, unrecognized or missing evidence defaults to ALLOW or BLOCK instead of REQUIRE_REVIEW.
Confirmed scope alignment with no evidence_refs is allowed.
The implementation changes DecisionResolver, Policy schema, PolicyEngine or GovernanceDecisionType.
The implementation expands into a generic provenance, lineage, artifact registry, attestation or evidence-graph subsystem.
Ailuros retries, repairs or orchestrates the external runtime.
Existing runtime governance regresses, validation fails, or forbidden files change.
